pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo avassutā avassutassa purisapuggalassa hatthagahaṇampi sādiyanti saṅghāṭikaṇṇagahaṇampi sādiyanti, santiṭṭhantipi. sallapantipi saṅketampi gacchanti. purisassapi abbhāgamanaṃ sādiyanti. channampi anupavisanti kāyampi tadatthāya upasaṃharanti, etassa asaddhammassa patisevanatthāya.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:1.3: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti,
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:1.4: “kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo avassutā avassutassa purisapuggalassa hatthagahaṇampi sādiyissanti. saṅghāṭikaṇṇagahaṇampi sādiyissanti. santiṭṭhissantipi. sallapissantipi. saṅketampi gacchissanti. purisassapi abbhāgamanaṃ sādiyissanti. channampi anupavisissanti. kāyampi tadatthāya upasaṃharissanti, etassa asaddhammassa patisevanatthāyāti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:1.5: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo avassutā avassutassa purisapuggalassa hatthagahaṇampi sādiyanti. saṅghāṭikaṇṇagahaṇampi sādiyanti. santiṭṭhantipi. sallapantipi saṅketampi gacchanti. purisassapi abbhāgamanaṃ sādiyanti. channampi anupavisanti. kāyampi tadatthāya upasaṃharanti, etassa asaddhammassa patisevanatthāyāti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:1.8: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo avassutā avassutassa purisapuggalassa hatthagahaṇampi sādiyissanti saṅghāṭikaṇṇagahaṇampi sādiyissanti santiṭṭhissantipi sallapissantipi saṅketampi gacchissanti. purisassapi abbhāgamanaṃ sādiyissanti. channampi anupavisissanti, kāyampi tadatthāya upasaṃharissanti etassa asaddhammassa patisevanatthāya.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:1.10: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:1.11.1: yā pana bhikkhunī avassutā avassutassa purisapuggalassa hatthagahaṇaṃ vā sādiyeyya saṅghāṭikaṇṇagahaṇaṃ vā sādiyeyya santiṭṭheyya vā sallapeyya vā saṃketaṃ vā gaccheyya purisassa vā abbhāgamanaṃ sādiyeyya channaṃ vā anupaviseyya kāyaṃ vā tadatthāya upasaṃhareyya etassa asaddhammassa patisevanatthāya ayampi pārājikā hoti asaṃvāsā aṭṭhavatthukāti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:2.1.10: manussapuriso, na yakkho na peto na tiracchānagato viññū paṭibalo kāyasaṃsaggaṃ samāpajjituṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:2.1.12: hattho nāma: kapparaṃ upādāya yāva agganakhā,
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:2.1.13: etassa asaddhammassa patisevanatthāya ubbhakkhakaṃ adhojāṇumaṇḍalagahaṇaṃ sādiyati āpatti thullaccayassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:2.1.15: etassa asaddhammassa patisevanatthāya nivatthaṃ vā pārutaṃ vā gahaṇaṃ sādiyati āpatti thullaccayassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:2.1.17: etassa asaddhammassa patisevanatthāya purisassa hatthapāse tiṭṭhati āpatti thullaccayassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:2.1.19: etassa asaddhammassa patisevanatthāya purisassa hatthapāse ṭhitā sallapati āpatti thullaccayassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:2.1.21: etassa asaddhammassa patisevanatthāya purisena itthannāmaṃ okāsaṃ āgacchāti vuttā gacchati pade pade āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:2.1.24: etassa asaddhammassa patisevanatthāya purisassa abbhāgamanaṃ sādiyati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:2.1.27: etassa asaddhammassa patisevanatthāya yena kenaci paṭicchannaṃ okāsaṃ paviṭṭhamatte āpatti thullaccayassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:2.1.29: etassa asaddhammassa patisevanatthāya purisassa hatthapāse ṭhitā kāyaṃ upasaṃharati āpatti thullaccayassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:2.1.33: seyyathāpi nāma tālo matthakacchinno abhabbo puna virūḷhiyā evameva bhikkhunī aṭṭhamaṃ vatthuṃ paripūrentī assamaṇī hoti asakyādhītā, tena vuccati pārājikā hotīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:2.1.35: saṃvāso nāma: ekakammaṃ ekuddeso samasikkhatā eso saṃvāso nāma.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:2.1.36: so tāya saddhiṃ natthi, tena vuccati asaṃvāsāti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pj8:2.2.12: yesaṃ bhikkhunī aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā āpajjitvā na labhati bhikkhunīhi saddhiṃ saṃvāsaṃ yathā pure tathā pacchā, pārājikā hoti asaṃvāsā.
